title: The Devil and Mr. O
paragraphs: Arch Oboler-hosted syndicated revival/repackaging of earlier Oboler radio plays, chiefly Lights Out material. 17, 1971 through Mar.
The run breaks into several distinct periods: Broader documented syndicated revival era (1971 to 1973) and 26-week frozen GRH release sequence (September 17, 1971 to March 10, 1972).

Names that turn up again and again in the surviving run include Arch Oboler (host and writer), Mercedes McCambridge (performer), Bea Benaderet (performer), Cathy Lewis (performer), Mary Jane Croft (performer), Ann Shephard (performer), and Byron Kane (performer).

The stories often return to Arch Oboler radio horror revival, horror, dread and the macabre, death, mortality and survival, supernatural and occult threat, science fiction and speculative danger, and transformation, identity and human nature.

The show also sits in a wider radio history that includes Revival of prewar and wartime Lights Out material, Syndication sales/audition package, 26-week 1971-72 syndicated sequence, and Broader 1971-73 Devil and Mr. O archive era.
